default-seo.title: Automate my SEO
default-seo.description: The fixes worth doing, ranked, with the briefs.
default-seo.name: SEO Assistant
default-seo.kickoff: Audit my website's SEO. List the ten highest-impact fixes ranked by effort, then draft the content briefs for the pages that need one.

default-inbox.title: Triage my inbox
default-inbox.description: What needs you today, with the replies drafted.
default-inbox.name: Inbox Triage
default-inbox.kickoff: Help me get through my inbox. Ask me which account to work on, then sort what arrives, tell me what actually needs me today, and draft the replies I can send as they are.

default-research.title: Research things for me
default-research.description: A briefing you can act on, with the sources.
default-research.name: Research Assistant
default-research.kickoff: I want you to research topics for me. Ask me what to look into first, then read around it and come back with a briefing I can act on, with the sources.

default-content.title: Write my content
default-content.description: The next piece drafted, plus three more to write.
default-content.name: Content Writer
default-content.kickoff: Help me write content. Ask me what I publish, who reads it and how I sound, then draft the next piece and suggest three more I could write after it.

default-meeting-notes.title: Turn my meetings into tasks
default-meeting-notes.description: Notes, and who owes what by when.
default-meeting-notes.name: Meeting Notes
default-meeting-notes.kickoff: Turn my meetings into notes and tasks. Ask me where the recordings or transcripts land, then summarise each one and list who owes what by when.

default-daily-brief.title: Brief me every morning
default-daily-brief.description: Your day: meetings, emails and what is due.
default-daily-brief.name: Daily Brief
default-daily-brief.kickoff: Every morning, tell me what my day looks like: my meetings, the emails that need me, and what is due.

default-follow-ups.title: Chase what I am waiting on
default-follow-ups.description: Who owes you an answer, and the nudge to send.
default-follow-ups.name: Follow-up Chaser
default-follow-ups.kickoff: Keep track of what I am waiting on. Every morning, tell me who owes me an answer and draft the nudge for each of them.

default-weekly-report.title: Build my weekly report
default-weekly-report.description: The numbers pulled and written up, every Friday.
default-weekly-report.name: Report Builder
default-weekly-report.kickoff: Every Friday, pull the week's numbers from my spreadsheet and write the report I send to the team.

agencies-client-report.title: Report to my clients
agencies-client-report.description: A weekly recap of the numbers, written for the client.
agencies-client-report.name: Client Reporting
agencies-client-report.kickoff: Help me set up a weekly client report. Ask me which client to start with and where their numbers live, then pull the figures, write the summary in plain language, and tell me what changed since last week.

agencies-proposal.title: Draft my proposals
agencies-proposal.description: Scope, pricing and timeline, in your usual tone.
agencies-proposal.name: Proposal Writer
agencies-proposal.kickoff: I want you to draft proposals for new clients. Ask me about the scope, the budget range and the deliverables, then write the proposal with pricing and a timeline, in the tone we already use with clients.

agencies-meeting-notes.title: Turn calls into action items
agencies-meeting-notes.description: Notes and owners after every client call.
agencies-meeting-notes.name: Meeting Notes
agencies-meeting-notes.kickoff: After every client call I want notes and action items. Ask me where the recordings or transcripts land, then summarise each one, list who owes what by when, and flag anything that changes the scope.

agencies-seo.title: Automate my SEO
agencies-seo.description: The fixes worth doing, ranked, with the briefs.
agencies-seo.name: SEO Assistant
agencies-seo.kickoff: Audit my website's SEO. List the ten highest-impact fixes ranked by effort, then draft the content briefs for the pages that need one.

agencies-lead-responder.title: Answer my new leads
agencies-lead-responder.description: Every enquiry answered, and posted to the team.
agencies-lead-responder.name: Lead Responder
agencies-lead-responder.kickoff: Answer every new enquiry from our contact form. Ask me where they arrive, then reply within minutes, ask the qualifying questions, and post the lead in Slack.

agencies-case-studies.title: Write my case studies
agencies-case-studies.description: A draft from the project, ready to publish.
agencies-case-studies.name: Case Study Writer
agencies-case-studies.kickoff: When a project closes, draft its case study. Ask me where the project notes live, then write the story, the results and a pull quote, and tell me what is missing to publish it.

agencies-inbox.title: Triage our shared inbox
agencies-inbox.description: What needs the team today, every morning.
agencies-inbox.name: Inbox Triage
agencies-inbox.kickoff: Every morning, sort our shared inbox and tell us in Slack what needs us today, with the replies drafted for the ones I can send as they are.

agencies-invoices.title: Chase my unpaid invoices
agencies-invoices.description: Who is late, and the reminder to send them.
agencies-invoices.name: Invoice Chaser
agencies-invoices.kickoff: Help me chase unpaid invoices. Ask me where my invoices live, then tell me every Monday who is late and draft the reminder for each of them.

ecommerce-product-copy.title: Write my product pages
ecommerce-product-copy.description: Titles and descriptions that match your catalogue.
ecommerce-product-copy.name: Product Copy
ecommerce-product-copy.kickoff: I want you to write product descriptions for my store. Ask me which products to start with, then write titles, descriptions and bullet points that match how the rest of the catalogue reads.

ecommerce-abandoned-cart.title: Win back abandoned carts
ecommerce-abandoned-cart.description: The recovery sequence, and when each email goes out.
ecommerce-abandoned-cart.name: Cart Recovery
ecommerce-abandoned-cart.kickoff: Help me recover abandoned carts. Ask me what my current flow looks like, then write the email sequence, tell me when each one should go out, and suggest what to test first.

ecommerce-reviews.title: Digest my customer reviews
ecommerce-reviews.description: What buyers keep complaining about, weekly.
ecommerce-reviews.name: Reviews Digest
ecommerce-reviews.kickoff: Read my recent customer reviews and support messages, group them by the problem behind them, and give me a weekly digest of what buyers complain about and what they love.

ecommerce-sales-report.title: Track my sales every morning
ecommerce-sales-report.description: Revenue, orders and anything that moved oddly.
ecommerce-sales-report.name: Sales Report
ecommerce-sales-report.kickoff: Give me a daily sales report. Ask me where my sales data lives, then send me revenue, orders and best sellers each morning, with anything that moved unusually called out.

ecommerce-support.title: Answer my customers
ecommerce-support.description: Order questions answered, the odd ones flagged.
ecommerce-support.name: Support Assistant
ecommerce-support.kickoff: Help me answer customer emails. Ask me where they arrive and what my policies are, then draft the reply to each order question and flag the ones that need me.

ecommerce-ads.title: Watch my ad spend
ecommerce-ads.description: What each campaign returned, and what to pause.
ecommerce-ads.name: Ads Watch
ecommerce-ads.kickoff: Keep an eye on my ad campaigns. Every Monday, tell me what each one spent and returned, and which ones I should pause or push.

ecommerce-newsletter.title: Write my newsletter
ecommerce-newsletter.description: This week's email, from what is new in the store.
ecommerce-newsletter.name: Newsletter Writer
ecommerce-newsletter.kickoff: Write my weekly newsletter. Ask me what is new in the store and how I usually sound, then draft the email and suggest two subject lines.

ecommerce-stock.title: Warn me before I run out
ecommerce-stock.description: Low stock and slow sellers, every week.
ecommerce-stock.name: Stock Watch
ecommerce-stock.kickoff: Watch my stock. Every week, tell me which products are about to run out at the current pace and which ones have stopped selling.

saas-changelog.title: Write my changelog
saas-changelog.description: Release notes a customer can actually read.
saas-changelog.name: Changelog Writer
saas-changelog.kickoff: I want a changelog written from what we ship. Ask me where our repository and releases live, then turn the merged work into release notes a customer can read, grouped by what it changes for them.

saas-issue-triage.title: Triage my issues
saas-issue-triage.description: Labelled, deduped, and ranked by what needs you.
saas-issue-triage.name: Issue Triage
saas-issue-triage.kickoff: Help me triage incoming issues. Ask me where they land, then label each one, judge how urgent it is, spot duplicates, and tell me every morning what deserves attention today.

saas-onboarding-emails.title: Onboard my new users
saas-onboarding-emails.description: The signup sequence, written and scheduled.
saas-onboarding-emails.name: Onboarding Emails
saas-onboarding-emails.kickoff: Design the onboarding email sequence for new signups. Ask me what the product does and what the first win looks like, then write each email and tell me when it should be sent.

saas-seo.title: Automate my SEO
saas-seo.description: The fixes worth doing, ranked, with the briefs.
saas-seo.name: SEO Assistant
saas-seo.kickoff: Audit my website's SEO. List the ten highest-impact fixes ranked by effort, then draft the content briefs for the pages that need one.

saas-churn.title: Spot accounts about to churn
saas-churn.description: Who went quiet, and what to send them.
saas-churn.name: Churn Watch
saas-churn.kickoff: Help me spot accounts about to churn. Ask me where usage and billing live, then tell me every week who went quiet and draft the message I should send them.

saas-support.title: Answer my support tickets
saas-support.description: A reply drafted from the docs, the bugs filed.
saas-support.name: Support Assistant
saas-support.kickoff: Help me with support. Ask me where tickets arrive, then draft a reply from our docs for each one and open an issue for the real bugs.

saas-errors.title: Triage my errors
saas-errors.description: New errors grouped, with the likely cause.
saas-errors.name: Error Triage
saas-errors.kickoff: Every morning, read the new errors in Sentry, group them by cause, and tell me in Slack which ones are worth fixing today.

saas-metrics.title: Send my weekly metrics
saas-metrics.description: Signups, activation and revenue, with what moved.
saas-metrics.name: Metrics Digest
saas-metrics.kickoff: Every Monday, send me the numbers that matter: signups, activation, revenue and churn, with what moved since last week and why.

sales-prospect-research.title: Research my prospects
sales-prospect-research.description: A briefing on the company before every call.
sales-prospect-research.name: Prospect Research
sales-prospect-research.kickoff: Before every call I want a briefing on the prospect. Ask me who to research first, then give me the company, the people, what they announced recently, and the angle I should open on.

sales-follow-ups.title: Chase my follow-ups
sales-follow-ups.description: Who went quiet, and the message to send them.
sales-follow-ups.name: Follow-up Assistant
sales-follow-ups.kickoff: Help me stay on top of follow-ups. Ask me where my pipeline lives, then tell me every morning who has gone quiet, and draft the follow-up I should send each of them.

sales-outreach.title: Write my cold outreach
sales-outreach.description: A first email and two follow-ups, per prospect.
sales-outreach.name: Outreach Writer
sales-outreach.kickoff: I want you to write cold outreach for me. Ask me who we sell to and what we sell, then write a first email and two follow-ups, personalised per prospect rather than templated.

sales-crm-hygiene.title: Keep my CRM clean
sales-crm-hygiene.description: Missing fields, stale stages and duplicates, weekly.
sales-crm-hygiene.name: CRM Assistant
sales-crm-hygiene.kickoff: Keep my CRM up to date. Ask me which CRM I use, then find records with missing fields, stale stages or duplicates, and give me a weekly list of what to fix.

sales-reply-sorter.title: Sort my campaign replies
sales-reply-sorter.name: Reply Sorter
sales-reply-sorter.kickoff: Sort every reply to my cold campaigns, draft my answer to the interested ones, and ping me in Slack when a prospect wants to talk.

sales-lead-responder.title: Answer my inbound leads
sales-lead-responder.name: Lead Responder
sales-lead-responder.kickoff: Answer every new contact form within five minutes. Ask me where they land, then reply, qualify the lead, and post it in Slack.

sales-call-notes.title: Log my sales calls
sales-call-notes.description: Notes and next steps, written to the CRM.
sales-call-notes.name: Call Notes
sales-call-notes.kickoff: After every sales call, write the notes and the next steps, and log them on the deal. Ask me where my recordings land first.

sales-pipeline.title: Review my pipeline
sales-pipeline.description: Deals at risk and what to do, every Monday.
sales-pipeline.name: Pipeline Review
sales-pipeline.kickoff: Every Monday, review my pipeline and tell me which deals are at risk, which are stuck, and what I should do about each this week.

recruiting-screening.title: Screen my applicants
recruiting-screening.description: Every application read, summarised and ranked.
recruiting-screening.name: Candidate Screening
recruiting-screening.kickoff: Help me screen applicants. Ask me for the role and what matters most in it, then review each application against it, summarise the candidate in five lines, and rank them for me.

recruiting-sourcing.title: Source my candidates
recruiting-sourcing.description: Profiles that fit, and the first message to each.
recruiting-sourcing.name: Sourcing Assistant
recruiting-sourcing.kickoff: I want you to source candidates for an open role. Ask me about the role, the seniority and the market, then find profiles that fit and draft the first message to each of them.

recruiting-job-posts.title: Write my job posts
recruiting-job-posts.description: The role described the way you actually speak.
recruiting-job-posts.name: Job Post Writer
recruiting-job-posts.kickoff: Write the job posting for a role I am opening. Ask me what the job actually involves and what we offer, then write the post the way we speak, not the way job boards do.

recruiting-scheduling.title: Schedule my interviews
recruiting-scheduling.description: Slots proposed, invites sent, reminders handled.
recruiting-scheduling.name: Interview Scheduler
recruiting-scheduling.kickoff: Handle interview scheduling for me. Ask me where my calendar and candidates live, then propose slots, send the invites, and remind me the day before each interview.

recruiting-updates.title: Keep candidates posted
recruiting-updates.description: Nobody left waiting on an answer.
recruiting-updates.name: Candidate Updates
recruiting-updates.kickoff: Keep candidates informed. Ask me where my pipeline lives, then tell me every week who has been waiting on an answer and draft the update for each of them.

recruiting-interview-prep.title: Prepare my interviews
recruiting-interview-prep.description: The profile and the questions, before each one.
recruiting-interview-prep.name: Interview Prep
recruiting-interview-prep.kickoff: Before every interview on my calendar, send me a briefing on the candidate and the questions I should ask for this role.

recruiting-references.title: Check my references
recruiting-references.name: Reference Checker
recruiting-references.kickoff: Handle reference checks. Ask me for the candidate and their referees, then write to each one, chase the answers, and summarise what they said.

recruiting-offers.title: Draft my offers
recruiting-offers.description: The offer letter, ready for signature.
recruiting-offers.name: Offer Writer
recruiting-offers.kickoff: Draft offer letters. Ask me for the role, the package and the start date, then write the letter from our template and prepare it for signature.

real-estate-leads.title: Follow up on my leads
real-estate-leads.description: Every enquiry answered and qualified the same day.
real-estate-leads.name: Lead Follow-up
real-estate-leads.kickoff: Help me follow up on new leads. Ask me where enquiries arrive, then reply to each one quickly, ask the qualifying questions, and tell me who is worth a call today.

real-estate-listings.title: Write my listings
real-estate-listings.description: Descriptions and highlights without the clichés.
real-estate-listings.name: Listing Writer
real-estate-listings.kickoff: I want you to write property listings. Ask me for the details of the property, then write the description, the highlights and a short version for social, without the usual clichés.

real-estate-market-watch.title: Watch my market
real-estate-market-watch.description: New listings, price changes and sales, weekly.
real-estate-market-watch.name: Market Watch
real-estate-market-watch.kickoff: Keep an eye on my market. Ask me which areas and price ranges I work in, then send me a weekly note on new listings, price changes and what sold.

real-estate-documents.title: Prepare my paperwork
real-estate-documents.description: Documents filled from the deal, and what is unsigned.
real-estate-documents.name: Document Assistant
real-estate-documents.kickoff: Help me with the paperwork on each deal. Ask me which documents I use, then prepare them from the deal details, check nothing is missing, and track what is still unsigned.

real-estate-viewings.title: Book my viewings
real-estate-viewings.name: Viewing Scheduler
real-estate-viewings.kickoff: Handle viewings for me. Ask me where my calendar lives, then propose slots to each buyer, confirm them, and remind everyone the day before.

real-estate-seller-updates.title: Report to my sellers
real-estate-seller-updates.description: A weekly update on visits and feedback.
real-estate-seller-updates.name: Seller Updates
real-estate-seller-updates.kickoff: Every Friday, write each seller an update on their property: visits, feedback and what I suggest next. Ask me where I track them first.

real-estate-social.title: Post my listings
real-estate-social.description: Each new property turned into posts.
real-estate-social.name: Listing Posts
real-estate-social.kickoff: When I add a new listing, turn it into posts for my social accounts, with a caption for each platform.

real-estate-nurture.title: Stay in touch with past clients
real-estate-nurture.description: Who to call this month, and why.
real-estate-nurture.name: Client Nurture
real-estate-nurture.kickoff: Help me stay in touch with past clients. Every month, tell me who I should reach out to and why, and draft the message.

legal-contract-review.title: Review my contracts
legal-contract-review.description: Risky clauses, gaps, and what to negotiate.
legal-contract-review.name: Contract Review
legal-contract-review.kickoff: Review contracts for me. Ask me what to look at first and what our usual positions are, then flag the risky clauses, what is missing, and what I should negotiate.

legal-drafting.title: Draft my documents
legal-drafting.description: A draft from your templates, plus the open decisions.
legal-drafting.name: Document Drafting
legal-drafting.kickoff: I want you to draft legal documents from our templates. Ask me which document and for which matter, then produce the draft and list every point that still needs my decision.

legal-summaries.title: Summarise my case files
legal-summaries.description: Facts, dates and obligations, with references.
legal-summaries.name: Case Summariser
legal-summaries.kickoff: Summarise long documents and case files for me. Ask me where they are, then give me the facts, the dates, the obligations and the open questions, with references back to the source.

legal-deadlines.title: Track my deadlines
legal-deadlines.description: A dated list, and a warning before anything is due.
legal-deadlines.name: Deadline Tracker
legal-deadlines.kickoff: Track deadlines and renewals for me. Ask me where the contracts and matters live, then keep a dated list and warn me well before anything comes due.

legal-intake.title: Handle my client intake
legal-intake.description: New enquiries qualified before the first call.
legal-intake.name: Client Intake
legal-intake.kickoff: Handle new client enquiries. Ask me what I need to know before taking a matter, then collect it from each enquiry and tell me who is worth a call.

legal-signatures.title: Chase my signatures
legal-signatures.description: What is still unsigned, and the reminder.
legal-signatures.name: Signature Tracker
legal-signatures.kickoff: Track what is out for signature. Every morning, tell me which documents are still unsigned and send the reminder for the ones that are late.

legal-research.title: Research a point of law
legal-research.description: What the sources say, with citations.
legal-research.name: Legal Research
legal-research.kickoff: I want you to research legal questions for me. Ask me the question and the jurisdiction, then come back with what the sources say, with citations I can check.

legal-time-entries.title: Prepare my time entries
legal-time-entries.description: The week's work turned into billable lines.
legal-time-entries.name: Time Entries
legal-time-entries.kickoff: Every Friday, go through my calendar and my emails and draft the week's time entries, matter by matter, for me to review.

creators-content-calendar.title: Plan my content
creators-content-calendar.description: A month of posts, each with a hook and an angle.
creators-content-calendar.name: Content Calendar
creators-content-calendar.kickoff: Help me plan my content. Ask me what I publish and who for, then build a calendar for the next month with a hook and an angle for each post.

creators-repurpose.title: Repurpose what I publish
creators-repurpose.description: One piece rewritten for every platform you're on.
creators-repurpose.name: Repurposing Assistant
creators-repurpose.kickoff: I want to get more out of each piece I publish. Ask me for a recent one, then turn it into posts for each platform I am on, rewritten for that platform rather than copied.

creators-newsletter.title: Write my newsletter
creators-newsletter.description: A draft in your voice, and what to cut from it.
creators-newsletter.name: Newsletter Writer
creators-newsletter.kickoff: Help me write my newsletter. Ask me what the issue should cover and how I usually sound, then draft it, and tell me what I could cut.

creators-seo.title: Automate my SEO
creators-seo.description: The fixes worth doing, ranked, with the briefs.
creators-seo.name: SEO Assistant
creators-seo.kickoff: Audit my website's SEO. List the ten highest-impact fixes ranked by effort, then draft the content briefs for the pages that need one.

creators-comments.title: Answer my comments
creators-comments.description: Replies drafted, the ones worth your time flagged.
creators-comments.name: Comment Replies
creators-comments.kickoff: Help me keep up with comments. Every day, read the new ones on my videos, draft the replies, and tell me which deserve an answer from me.

creators-scheduler.title: Schedule my posts
creators-scheduler.description: The week queued on every platform.
creators-scheduler.name: Post Scheduler
creators-scheduler.kickoff: Every Monday, take the posts I have ready and schedule them across my platforms for the week, at the hours that work best.

creators-ideas.title: Find my next ideas
creators-ideas.description: What your audience is asking, every week.
creators-ideas.name: Idea Scout
creators-ideas.kickoff: Every week, look at what people in my niche are asking and discussing, and give me five ideas worth a post, with the angle for each.

creators-analytics.title: Read my numbers
creators-analytics.description: What worked this week, and what to repeat.
creators-analytics.name: Audience Report
creators-analytics.kickoff: Every Monday, tell me how last week's content did: what grew, what flopped, and what I should make more of.

productivity-inbox.title: Triage my inbox
productivity-inbox.description: What needs you today, with the replies drafted.
productivity-inbox.name: Inbox Triage
productivity-inbox.kickoff: Help me get through my inbox. Ask me which account to work on, then sort what arrives, tell me what actually needs me today, and draft the replies I can send as they are.

productivity-meeting-notes.title: Turn my meetings into tasks
productivity-meeting-notes.description: Notes, and who owes what by when.
productivity-meeting-notes.name: Meeting Notes
productivity-meeting-notes.kickoff: Turn my meetings into notes and tasks. Ask me where the recordings or transcripts land, then summarise each one and list who owes what by when.

productivity-weekly-review.title: Prepare my weekly review
productivity-weekly-review.description: What moved and what is stuck, every Friday.
productivity-weekly-review.name: Weekly Review
productivity-weekly-review.kickoff: Prepare my weekly review. Ask me where my work is tracked, then tell me every Friday what moved, what is stuck, and what I said I would do and did not.

productivity-research.title: Research things for me
productivity-research.description: A briefing you can act on, with the sources.
productivity-research.name: Research Assistant
productivity-research.kickoff: I want you to research topics for me. Ask me what to look into first, then read around it and come back with a briefing I can act on, with the sources.

productivity-daily-brief.title: Brief me every morning
productivity-daily-brief.description: Your day: meetings, emails and what is due.
productivity-daily-brief.name: Daily Brief
productivity-daily-brief.kickoff: Every morning, tell me what my day looks like: my meetings, the emails that need me, and what is due.

productivity-follow-ups.title: Chase what I am waiting on
productivity-follow-ups.description: Who owes you an answer, and the nudge to send.
productivity-follow-ups.name: Follow-up Chaser
productivity-follow-ups.kickoff: Keep track of what I am waiting on. Every morning, tell me who owes me an answer and draft the nudge for each of them.

productivity-weekly-report.title: Build my weekly report
productivity-weekly-report.description: The numbers pulled and written up, every Friday.
productivity-weekly-report.name: Report Builder
productivity-weekly-report.kickoff: Every Friday, pull the week's numbers from my spreadsheet and write the report I send to the team.

productivity-docs.title: Keep my docs up to date
productivity-docs.name: Docs Keeper
productivity-docs.kickoff: Keep our internal docs current. Every week, find the pages that have gone stale and draft the update for each.

support-help-center.title: Keep my help center up to date
support-help-center.description: The questions that keep coming back, turned into articles.
support-help-center.name: Help Center Writer
support-help-center.kickoff: Help me keep my help center up to date. Ask me where support questions arrive, then tell me each week which ones keep coming back and draft the article that answers each of them.

support-escalations.title: Flag the unhappy customers
support-escalations.description: Who is upset today, why, and what to tell them.
support-escalations.name: Escalation Watch
support-escalations.kickoff: Watch my support inbox for unhappy customers. Every morning, tell me who is upset and why, and draft what I should answer to each of them.

finance-cash-brief.title: Brief me on my cash every week
finance-cash-brief.description: What came in, what went out, what is due.
finance-cash-brief.name: Cash Brief
finance-cash-brief.kickoff: Every Monday, tell me where my cash stands: what came in last week, what went out, and which payments are due in the next two.

finance-expenses.title: Sort my receipts
finance-expenses.description: Every receipt filed, with what is missing.
finance-expenses.name: Receipt Sorter
finance-expenses.kickoff: Help me keep my receipts in order. Ask me where they arrive, then file each one in my spreadsheet with its amount, date and category, and tell me which ones are missing at the end of the month.

finance-failed-payments.title: Recover my failed payments
finance-failed-payments.description: Each failed charge, with the email to win it back.
finance-failed-payments.name: Payment Recovery
finance-failed-payments.kickoff: Help me recover failed payments. Every morning, list the charges that failed yesterday and draft the email I should send to each customer.
